== Description ==

Players at a Friday Cube Draft table during the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025: [[Apollo Chu]] (foreground left, blue ''SpongeBob'' T-shirt), [[Benji Chu]] (foreground right from behind, navy #99 Judge T-shirt, grey cap), [[Nathan Davis]] (back left, blue-and-yellow M cap, beard, black hoodie), and [[Jonny Chu]] (right, black hoodie, glasses).
